name: Beowulf
subtitle: Beast-Slayer
description: Slaughter Brawlers and Bosses with devastating single target attacks.
lore: A true legend even in his youth, the great warrior Beowulf was famed for slaying the monster Grendel, his even more fearsome mother, and—later, as king—a terrible dragon. In today’s Asgard, he finds his strength restored, yet he resents the need to continue fighting, as he had reconciled with his age and had been ready for his reward in Valhalla.
divinity_generator: Gain [50] Divinity when inflicting a Strong hit which is doubled against Brawlers or Bosses.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +25%, Armor Multiplier +15%, Weapon Multiplier +15%

skills.name: Naegling’s Wrath
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 340%ATK. If the target is a Brawler or Boss, increase ATK by 5% (stacking up to 3 times).

skills.name: Thane's Wrath
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (410%ATK+3%targetHP). If the target is a Brawler or Boss, increase this hero’s CDMG by 10% (stacking up to 3 times).

skills.name: Giant Slayer
skills.description: This hero inflicts 20% increased damage to Brawlers and Bosses
skills.awakening_bonus: Strong hits inflict additional 1% Enemy Max HP damage. If the target is a Brawler or Boss, this bonus is doubled.

skills.name: Grendel's Doom
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 300%ATK. If the target is a Brawler or Boss, then decrease the target’s ATK by 5% (stacking up to 3 times).
skills.awakening_bonus: Guarantees the attack will Strong Hit.

imprint_passive: Inflicts 10% increased damage to Brawler and Bosses.
